title: Add KV cache fragmentation ratio + allocator health metrics
creator: Omar El-Sayed
description:
Goal
Ship allocator-level metrics that quantify KV arena fragmentation and allocator “health” so we can:
- detect fragmentation-induced tail latency spikes (p95/p99)
- set safe compaction triggers/thresholds (ENG-4823/4824)
- support rollout guardrails + automated rollback (SRE)

Context
We’re seeing long-lived KV allocations + churn leave the KV arena fragmented. Today we have limited signal beyond overall KV bytes used, which is not sufficient to explain OOMs / eviction bursts / latency spikes. We need a small, stable set of metrics that are cheap to compute and have predictable cardinality.

Scope (this ticket)
1) Implement a fragmentation ratio metric
- Definition (allocator-level): fragmentation_ratio = 1 - (largest_free_contiguous_bytes / total_free_bytes)
  - Interpretation: 0.0 = perfectly contiguous free space; 1.0 = highly fragmented free space.
  - Edge cases: if total_free_bytes == 0, emit 0.0 (and rely on free_bytes to convey pressure).

2) Add allocator health metrics (minimal set)
- total_bytes (arena capacity)
- used_bytes
- free_bytes
- largest_free_contiguous_bytes
- alloc_failures_total (or kv_alloc_oom_total) with reason labels kept low-cardinality
- eviction_events_total (if already available via eviction module, otherwise stub; final wiring may land with ENG-4825)

3) Export/ingest
- Export via existing runtime metrics pipeline (Prometheus-style counters/gauges).
- Ensure metrics are available per “pool”/cluster and model route without adding high-cardinality labels.
  - Proposed labels: deployment_mode (hosted|dedicated|private), tier (free|pro|enterprise|internal), model_family (e.g., llama|qwen|mistral), gpu_class (a100|h100|l40s)
  - Explicitly avoid: request_id, prompt hash, session_id.

4) Dashboard linkage
- Add to standard runtime dashboard (ENG-4830 is the panel work; this ticket ensures metric names and initial wiring are correct).
- Provide a quick reference panel list to SRE: fragmentation_ratio, largest_free_contiguous_bytes, free_bytes, alloc_failures_total, p99 overlay.

Required references
- Metrics naming/definitions must match: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/performance-standards/kv-cache-fragmentation-metrics-standard.json
- Align with guardrails: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/hosted-api-tail-latency-guardrails.json

Implementation notes
- Computation cost: largest_free_contiguous_bytes and total_free_bytes can be derived from the free-list metadata already maintained by the allocator. Do NOT scan all pages on scrape.
- Update frequency: metrics are sampled on scrape; values can be computed from cached allocator stats updated on allocate/free paths.
- Thread safety: allocator stats must be consistent under concurrent allocation/free; prefer atomic counters + a single “largest_free_block” tracked via free-list ops.
- Testing: add unit tests for:
  - fragmentation_ratio edge cases (0 free bytes; single free block; multiple blocks)
  - regression test that stats remain non-negative and do not overflow under churn

Acceptance criteria
- Metrics emitted and visible in staging:
  - kv_cache_fragmentation_ratio (gauge)
  - kv_cache_total_bytes (gauge)
  - kv_cache_used_bytes (gauge)
  - kv_cache_free_bytes (gauge)
  - kv_cache_largest_free_contiguous_bytes (gauge)
  - kv_cache_alloc_failures_total (counter)
- All metrics documented inline (help strings) + referenced in the metrics standard doc.
- No measurable perf regression in CI perf suite attributable to metric collection (<= 0.3% runtime overhead on decode-heavy workloads).
- SRE sign-off that labels/cardinality are acceptable.

Rollout
- Land behind existing runtime metrics gate (no new feature flag required).
- Enable in internal canary first; confirm dashboards populate; then roll into hosted subset.

Links
- Epic: ENG-4821
- PR (implementation): sources/github/redwood/pr-19342-add-kv-fragmentation-counters.json
- Dashboard panels ticket: ENG-4830
